fix.notes: The `soonest_elimination` formula derives from the elimination condition `remaining_runs + hits < threshold`: solving for the minimum additional runs k gives `k >= TOTAL_RUNS - runs - threshold + hits + 1`. Using `min_hits_in_undecided` with `default=threshold` ensures the value is non-negative when no undecided cards exist (though the block is guarded by `num_undecided > 0`). No other issues found.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The rotation hype message showed "Next new cards confirmed in N runs time" but:
1. Used "runs time" instead of the clearer "hours" (since `TOTAL_RUNS = 168` maps directly to hours in a week).
2. Gave no indication of how soon the *first card could be eliminated* from rotation contention.

## What changed (`magic/rotation.py`)

- Renamed "runs time" → "hours" in the "Next new cards confirmed" line.
- Added `min_hits_in_undecided`: the fewest hits any still-undecided card has accumulated.
- Computed `soonest_elimination = TOTAL_RUNS - runs + min_hits_in_undecided - threshold + 1`: the minimum additional runs before any undecided card can be mathematically eliminated.
- Appended `\nNext elimination in {soonest_elimination} hours.` to the hype message when there are undecided cards.
- Updated the existing test assertion to match the new wording and include the new line.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks).
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit magic.rotation` — 845 passed, 1 skipped (no failures).

Fixes #12248
